expected_output.reasoning:
The expected output requires a detailed, substantive report: a full inventory of long-term Bedrock API keys discovered via ListServiceSpecificCredentials across all IAM users, per-key details (masked key ID or owner, status, grant/risk tier, removal recommendation with steps and doc link), explicit statements about IAM not tracking last-used time, specific risk-tier rating rules, handling of access-denied as partial, a statement that the audit was read-only with no changes made, and masking of sensitive identifiers (API key IDs, aliases, account IDs).

The agent's actual response is merely a placeholder/status message saying it started a read-only audit and will send the full report later. It contains none of the required substantive content: no list of API keys, no risk tiers, no removal recommendations, no documentation links, no statement about last-used unknown, no masking considerations, and no final report content at all. It only states intent to deliver a report in the future, not an actual completed report.

Therefore the response does not meet the expected output criteria, as it fails to deliver any of the required analysis, findings, or recommendations.
